facts.text: Audrey mentioned that Pixie has been keeping them busy and has not had a chance to check out a hiking spot.

evidence.quote: I know right? She's so cute! Pixie's been keeping us busy, so I haven't had a chance to check out that hiking spot yet.

facts.text: Audrey stated that Pixie has settled in well with the other dogs and is now playing and exploring the house with them.

evidence.quote: Pixie's fitting in great! It took her a few days to get used to the other dogs, but now they're awesome friends. They love playing and exploring the house - so cute!

facts.text: Audrey confirmed that Pepper has adjusted well to her and is now always together with Pixie.

evidence.quote: Pepper took a bit to get used to her, but now they're always together!
